text:
evan_cs: Heads-up — Dune Labs dedicated pool activation targeted Wed 10:00am PT. Need final decisions on quota, autoscale policy, and load test window. Renewal flagged if we miss SLA for first 72h, so this run matters. Who can own runbook + ramp plan?

maria_eng: I can own the model pinning + perf profile. Suggest pin to `dune-model-v2.3` + use q6-int8 quant profile to keep cost down. Will validate memory footprint tonight.

liam_sre: From infra: propose autoscale policy: min_nodes=4, max_nodes=16, scale_step=2, target_gpu_util=70%, cooldown=3m. Also add a rate-based circuit breaker at route level.

alex_customer: Appreciate the heads-up. We need to validate with our synthetic traffic generator (20k concurrent users). Can you provide a load endpoint + temp token? Also confirm whether prefix cache priming will be included in the test.

sarah_se: I'll run the customer enablement session Tue 2:00pm PT to walk Dune through credentials + diagnostics. I'll capture questions and post a short enablement doc. Evan — can you drop the runbook link here when ready?

evan_cs: Draft runbook is in the ops drive, will paste minimal checklist here once updated. Plan for the load test: 2hr soak window on Wed after handover — ramp 0->4k qps over 30m, hold 60m, ramp down 30m. Include a cold-start sweep first 10m to validate kv-cache priming.

maria_eng: Load test script ready — using `k6` for request patterns. Example snippet:
```bash
k6 run --vus 2000 --duration 30m dune_loadtest.js \  # ramp handled in script
```
Script includes a priming pass that posts common prefixes to accelerate prefix/KV cache. I'll attach payload set to the drive.

liam_sre: Monitoring + alarms: we'll wire token-level latency SLI dashboards (p95, p99), GPU utilization, and autoscale events. Also enabling billing-alert at $X/day threshold to catch runaway cost. If p95 > 500ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows, automatic rollback to fallback model variant `dune-v2-compat`.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: dedicated-pool/dune-labs -> staging -> production. Rollout window Wed 9:15am PT. CI: green.

alex_customer: OK thanks. We'll standby for the token and endpoint. Also request a short post-test feedback form so our product team can capture quality regressions.

sarah_se: I'll own the feedback capture — will circulate a 5-question form immediately after soak. Questions will include perceived latency, error rate, and semantic quality.

evan_cs: Final checklist (quick):
- runbook link + creds (maria / evan)
- autoscale policy applied (liam)
- loadtest script + payloads (maria)
- monitoring dashboards + billing alert (liam)
- enablement session (sarah Tue 2pm)
- post-test survey (sarah)
- fallback model & routing policy (maria/liam)

Please add anything missing. Goal: green across perf + stability within 72h to de-risk renewal. :thumbsup:

maria_eng: Added runbook link and payloads to drive. ping me if you need a quick check on quant profile before Wed.

liam_sre: I'll post autoscale policy diff to infra PR in ~20m. Will also run a preflight smoke at 8:30am Wed to validate scaling events.

evan_cs: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the customer and confirm the token once liam posts preflight success.

sarah_se: Noted — will capture enablement notes and FAQ during Tue session.

alex_customer: Thanks all — excited to get this live.
